messages:
Noor: Tiny hypothetical: you can 'borrow' one non-sensitive thing from a friendly office robot for a day. What do you take? One-liners only. :robot_face:
Ben: Portable espresso arm. Attaches to my mug and never stops. :coffee:
Ava: A miniature whiteboard projector that follows you and annotates your jokes. :mag:
Diego: A tiny drone that fetches snacks from the kitchen. Respectfully. :package:
lunch-bot: Poll created  react with 1 = espresso, 2 = projector, 3 = snack drone, 4 = other
Noor: Bonus: if "other" say one word. Mine: "mood-light"
Ben: :one: also would demand a manual for the espresso arm. Safety first. :ok_hand:
Ava: :two: so every idea looks more brilliant in slides. :star2:
Diego: :three: because hunger is the true sprint killer.
Ava: other: :headphones: "silence-box"
Ben: GIF: https://media.giphy.com/media/l0MYt5jPR6QX5pnqM/giphy.gif "robot butler"
Noor: Poll closes at 5pm. Winner gets fictional brag rights and an emoji crown. :crown:
